title: Applicationinteraction delivers-value Applicationservice
description: The joint behaviour carried out by the collaborating components produces the outcome that gives an externally offered application service its worth to consumers, such as a checkout saga delivering the completed-order result of an ordering service.
x-dr-evidence: Service documentation or an API contract states that the service's operation outcome (e.g. order confirmed) is produced only when the saga or choreography completes, and the saga's final step returns or publishes that result.
